hooks.command: unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_COMMON_DIR GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES GIT_DISCOVERY_ACROSS_FILESYSTEM GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_CONFIG GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS GIT_CONFIG_COUNT GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM GIT_GRAFT_FILE GIT_SHALLOW_FILE GIT_REPLACE_REF_BASE GIT_IMPLICIT_WORK_TREE GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS GIT_PREFIX; command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit $?; repo=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); git_status=$?; if [ "$git_status" -ne 0 ]; then if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then git rev-parse --show-toplevel >/dev/null; exit $?; fi; probe=$(pwd -P) || exit $?; while [ "$probe" != / ] && [ ! -e "$probe/.git" ] && [ ! -L "$probe/.git" ]; do probe=${probe%/*}; [ -n "$probe" ] || probe=/; done; if [ ! -e "$probe/.git" ] && [ ! -L "$probe/.git" ]; then exit 0; fi; git rev-parse --show-toplevel >/dev/null; exit $?; fi; cd "$repo/metasystem" && bash scripts/agents/supervision-hook.sh devin end
